entries.name: Monkey
entries.style: chibi cube pet, deliberately blocky (Kenney Cube Pets), coloured as a Japanese macaque (snow monkey): pale grey-white fur, red face and ear insides; stylized size: 0.6 m to the top of the head, about a real macaque's height sitting up or standing with its head raised (0.45-0.55 m at the shoulder on all fours), so it sits under the cube-pet panda (0.9 m) and lion (1.3 m) in roughly the real animals' ratio and reaches a 1.7 m adult's knee; rigid parts moved by node tracks, no skin; colour map flattened to flat colours

source.author: Kenney (kenney.nl)
source.note: The plan's own source (wave-1 row 24). Same zip and route as the panda and lion: ingested through Blender, with Textures/colormap.png as an extra member; the colour map flattens to 24 clusters: the 20 orange-brown clusters (a baked top-to-bottom gradient on the fur) -> fur, the tan face plate and ear insides (#e7b691) -> face, the pink tongue (#e792bd) -> mouth, #4c4f5d -> dark (eyes, nose), #ededf4 -> eye. Recoloured from Kenney's brown monkey to a snow monkey (pale fur, red face) on the indigo script.
